## Hypothesis

The VWAP_CONTINUATION profit-lock variant (chandelier profit-lock with trailing stop) aims to improve edge capture on J's bearish reversal days while maintaining discipline on loser days. The hypothesis is that a trailing profit-lock will allow winners to run further, increasing edge_capture above the OP-16 floor of 771, without excessively increasing concentration (top5_pct <200%).

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Unchanged VWAP_CONTINUATION detector – first ≤10:30 ET bar that continues the trend established by the first three RTH closes relative to session VWAP.  
**Exit:** Standard v15 TP1 (+50% at 2/3 qty) + chandelier profit-lock that arms at +5% favor and trails 0.15 off the high-water mark (HWM × (1‑0.15)). Runner stop moves to breakeven after TP1. Catastrophe premium stop remains −50% (Safe) / −7% bear / −5% bull (Bold). Time stop 15:50 ET.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Qty=28 contracts requires $25K+ equity (per risk‑rules.md position‑sizing table). The BS‑synthetic P&L scales linearly with qty; a $1K paper account would realize ≈14% of the headline numbers.
2. **Sample bias:** Walk‑forward conducted over 2025‑Q3 through 2026‑Q1 (3 quarters, ≈225 trades). The sample is in‑sample for the walk‑forward procedure; overfit risk is moderate because the variant adds no new free parameters (only profit‑lock mode). No walk‑forward OOS split was performed in this Stage‑1 run.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (the Stage‑1 run is BS‑synthetic walk‑forward without an explicit held‑out OOS window; see provenance).
4. **Real‑fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (the run uses Black‑Scholes synthetic pricing; real OPRA fills have not been validated).
5. **Failure modes:**

6. **Concentration:** total_pnl = −$1464.23 (negative), so top5_pct is undefined (reported as 999.0). With negative aggregate P&L, concentration disclosure is not meaningful; the variant fails the OP‑16 edge_capture floor regardless.

## Pre-merge gate

- Walk‑forward OOS test (e.g., 2026‑Q2 held out) must produce edge_capture ≥771 and top5_pct <200%.

- No regression on anchor days (i.e., the variant must not turn any winner into a loser larger than the current baseline).
